items.title: Changes in Nervous System during Addiction and Tolerance (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Changes in Nervous System during Addiction and Tolerance: a main subheading of 15.7.1 Addiction, Tolerance and Withdrawal Symptoms, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 47-47.

blocks.text: Nasha-awar drugs dimagh ke un hisson par asar karti hain jo lutf (pleasure) aur hosle (motivation) ko qaboo karte hain. Jab yeh drugs dimagh tak pohanchti hain to presynaptic neurons dopamine neurotransmitter chhorte hain, jo khushi aur inaam (reward) ka ehsas deta hai. Kitab ke mutabiq drug ke molecules presynaptic neuron mein dopamine wapas jazb karne wale receptors ko band kar dete hain. Is liye bohat sa dopamine synaptic cleft mein jama ho jata hai. Dimagh is ka aadi ho kar postsynaptic neuron par dopamine receptors ki tadaad kam kar deta hai. Isi se tolerance hoti hai, yaani wahi lutf ya inaam ke liye zyada khuraak chahiye. Jab drug achanak band ki jaye to dopamine ka ikhraj naarmal ho jata hai, lekin receptors kam hone ki wajah se postsynaptic neuron kam jagta hai aur withdrawal symptoms aati hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar numbered synapses. 1 Aam synapse: synaptic cleft mein chhoota dopamine receptors tak jata aur presynaptic neuron wapas jazb kar leta hai. 2 Dawa wala synapse: dawa ke molecules reabsorption receptors par baith jate hain, dopamine jama hota hai. 3 Dimagh dhal jata hai: postsynaptic neuron par dopamine receptors kam. 4 Dawa hata di gayi: dopamine ka ikhraj aam magar receptors ab bhi kam.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chaaron panels ko tarteeb se parhein: (1) aam synapse mein dopamine receptors tak ja kar wapas jazb ho jata hai; (2) drug wapas jazb hona rok deti hai, dopamine jama hota hai; (3) dimagh receptors kam kar deta hai, is liye zyada drug chahiye (tolerance); (4) drug band ho to dopamine naarmal hai magar receptors kam hain, is liye neuron kam jagta hai (withdrawal).
